name: Chat history, selections — none
summary: Select turns every row into a choice: a 24px checkbox appears at the left and the text indents to 48. The nav swaps Search and Select for Select all and Cancel.

looseEnds.title: There is no Delete button until something is ticked
looseEnds.detail: With nothing selected the foot of the screen is empty. The button appears only once a row is picked, so nothing tells a user what selection is for before they commit to it.
looseEnds.ask: Is the button absent, or present and disabled, before the first tick?

looseEnds.title: The overflow control stays on every row while the row is also a checkbox
looseEnds.detail: Selection adds a 24px checkbox at the left but leaves the per-row overflow button in place at x=309. Nothing says what tapping the row body does in this mode, or what the overflow menu offers when other chats are already ticked.
looseEnds.ask: Does the row body toggle the tick in selection, and is the overflow menu reachable at all?
